items.heading: Grapevine Daily Quote October 21
items.text: The deception of others is nearly always rooted in the deception of ourselves.
items.attribution: AA Co-Founder, Bill W., August 1961, “This Matter of Honesty”, The Language of the Heart

items.heading: Cita Diaria con La Viña Octubre 21
items.text: Quejarse no es un paso de acción.
items.attribution: “Destilación del espíritu”. INDIANÁPOLIS, INDIANA, AGOSTO DE 1982. Del AA Grapevine
